title: RICOCHET OFF STEEL
why: His yes to rounds that ricochet off steel. A round you fire that reaches a metal wall at a glancing angle (a locked-room wall, a keyed door or a vehicle wreck) no longer just dies there: it turns about the face, keeps 60 percent of its damage, flies on a little way and throws a bright spark and a ping. It bounces once. A round that hits head-on, a round on concrete or wood, and every round an enemy fires behave exactly as before, so this is only a bank shot for you. A glancing round at a wreck now glances instead of punching through, the wall is still damaged by the strike, and the bot raids are untouched.
now: Your rounds glance once off steel walls at a shallow angle, with a spark and a ping.
